topSignals.title: Eleventh consecutive quiet day — Elcogen now 23 days quiet, Topsoe 90 days.
topSignals.text: Dedicated searches for both priority stacks (English and German), this cycle's Tier 2 rotation round 4 (SolydEra, Mitsubishi Power — completing the current Tier 2 cycle) and sweep, the Tier 3 rotation (cycle 12, round 3: Plansee, Huatsing Power, Ningbo SOFCMAN, Chaozhou Three-Circle/CCTC, Delta Electronics, Shell) and two further Tier 3 sweeps, and broad AI-datacenter/hyperscaler (English and German), regulation, competing-power, market/financials, research/IP and scientific-paper checks all returned only recycled/already-logged background or unconfirmable items (see notes below). Nothing confirmed beat or neared any row in SOFC_Benchmark_Records.md. For Dominic: no action needed on the LCOE model today; SPP's own FERC large-load show-cause answer (due Nov 20) still has not produced analyzable trade-press coverage, now five days running, and the FERC Docket No. EL26-68 (Commissioner Lacerte's concurrence, Southwest Power Pool) item flagged yesterday remains unfetchable (two further direct-fetch attempts both failed with client errors) — still not adopted. items.text: Elcogen (priority): 23 days quiet (since the Nov 2 Hygreen Energy MoU). No new item found today in English or German sources; results recirculated the already-logged May 2026 elcoStack E3000 G2 mass-manufacturable platform launch and the Sept 2026 Metrosert testing-expansion deal.

Topsoe (priority): 90 days quiet on SOFC/SOEC specifically (since the Aug 27 H1 2026 results/SOEC pathway reset). No new item found today; Topsoe's press feed remains active but non-solid-oxide (SOEC-for-PtX, e-methanol with Forestal, e-SAF with Carbon Neutral Fuels, DKK 25M grid-access funding, DKK 4.4bn PtX restructuring) in both English and German searches.

Today's Tier 2 dedicated rotation (SolydEra, Mitsubishi Power — round 4, completing the current cycle): no new item for either; results recycled SolydEra's Hannover Messe 2026 PMX-platform launch and Mitsubishi Power's Takasago SOEC test-module background (non-SOFC).

Tier 2 sweep ("Bloom Energy OR FuelCell Energy OR Ceres Power OR Sunfire OR SolydEra"): no new item; recycled Bloom's 2024-vintage 60% efficiency milestone and a dateless "Bloom Energy to supply Daroga Power" listing that could not be confirmed as new.

Today's Tier 3 dedicated rotation (cycle 12, round 3: Plansee, Huatsing Power, Ningbo SOFCMAN, Chaozhou Three-Circle/CCTC, Delta Electronics, Shell): no new item for any of the six; results recycled Plansee's standing Fraunhofer IKTS SOEC pilot-plant background, Huatsing/Ningbo SOFCMAN's standing Chinese-securities sector notes, Chaozhou Three-Circle's standing Ceres/Weichai-licensing adjacency, Delta's standing Ceres/Centrica off-grid data-center solution, and Shell's already-logged 10 MW Ceres SOEC module contract.
Competitor roster: SOFC systems for data centers

Bloom Energy: Deployed/signed at multiple named sites — Oracle/Project Jupiter, AEP/Google Cheyenne Fuel Cell LLC (702 MW/$4B, 20-yr PPA), Brookfield EaaS, Nebius (328 MW/$2.6B), Equinix (>100 MW/19 sites), Aligned "Project Phoenix" (2 GW), Hitachi (Japan), SK Eternix (28 MW, operational), NTT DATA (900 MW, global, shipments from 2027).

FuelCell Energy (incl. HyAxiom-branded products): Signed orders/PPAs — Fit Energy (up to 380 MW), Inuverse Korea (up to 100 MW), Texas CRA (75 MW), SDCL (up to 450 MW). Also hosting the DOE/national-lab-backed StabilityMax R&D testbed in Danbury, CT. No named commercial deployment live yet.
Doosan Fuel Cell/HyAxiom: Signed order — US AI data center supply contract (KRW 823.6B); supplies SOFC stacks to Reverion. No named data-center site of its own yet.
Convion: Pipeline-only/pre-commercial under HD Hyundai ownership; no named data-center customer.
SK ecoplant: Pipeline-only; no named data-center deployment.
Ceres Power's SOFC licensees (Doosan, Delta Electronics, Weichai): Licensing/pipeline-only; no named data-center deployment via Ceres licensing directly.
Reverion: Pipeline-only — Doosan-supplied SOFC stacks for rSOC power plants (Germany); no named data-center customer yet.
Petra Power: Pre-commercial, no named customer; first infrastructure deployment targeted 2028.
EGEN Energy (China, watch-list): Pre-commercial/early-stage; no named data-center customer yet.
